tools.name: show
tools.description: Show the user an image file in the Lightbox, the strip above their prompt. Use it whenever you want the user to see an image: a screenshot you took, an image you generated or edited, a diagram you rendered, or an image file you found. Accepts PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, TIFF, BMP and SVG. Images you open with the Read tool, and images tools return, appear there by themselves.

children: Images from this session appear here: whatever Claude reads, captures, generates or sends you, and what you paste.
